name: Prayers
description: Prayer times calculated offline: next prayer and countdown in the bar, a to-scale day (Horizon) or ruled timetable (Compact) panel, Arabic and English, calculation methods, iqama offsets, Hijri date, Friday istijabah and optional notifications with a chime

locationLabelAr.description: Arabic location label. Shown instead of the location label when prayer names are Arabic.

latitude.description: Latitude. Explicit coordinates avoid ambiguous city matching.

timezone.description: IANA timezone. IANA timezone, for example Asia/Riyadh or Europe/London. Must match the prayer location.

calculationMethod.description: Calculation method (0-99). Calculation authority. Pick it on the panel; ids are AlAdhan's: 0 Jafari, 1 Karachi, 2 ISNA, 3 MWL, 4 Umm al-Qura (default), 5 Egypt, 7 Tehran, 8 Gulf, 9 Kuwait, 10 Qatar, 11 Singapore, 12 France, 13 Turkey, 14 Russia, 15 Moonsighting, 16 Dubai, 17 Malaysia, 18 Tunisia, 19 Algeria, 20 Indonesia, 21 Morocco, 22 Portugal, 23 Jordan, 99 custom.

highLatitudeRule.description: High-latitude rule (one of: Middle of the night, One seventh, Angle based)

shafaq.description: Shafaq (one of: General, Red, White). Used by the Moonsighting Committee method.

tune.description: Per-time tuning. Nine local-engine minute offsets: Imsak,Fajr,Sunrise,Dhuhr,Asr,Maghrib,Sunset,Isha,Midnight. The panel edits the six prayer and sunrise values.

customMethodSettings.description: Custom method settings. Config-only values for method 99: Fajr angle, Maghrib angle, Isha angle. Empty or null values default to 15°, sunset, 15°.

panelStyle.description: Panel layout (one of: Horizon, Compact). Horizon draws the day to scale with window lengths. Compact is the ruled timetable card.

arabicFont.description: Arabic font family. Font used for Arabic prayer names. The bar's monospace font has no Arabic glyphs.

barDisplay.description: Bar display (one of: Strip + countdown, Icon only, Name + countdown, Name + time, Countdown only)

notificationSound.description: Chime with prayer notifications. Play a sound when a prayer notification is delivered. Off leaves the notification silent.

notificationSoundFile.description: Chime sound file. Path to your own sound file (ogg, wav, flac or mp3). Empty plays the bundled chime.

iqamaFajr.description: Fajr iqama (min after adhan) (0-60). Minutes between the adhan and the congregational start. 0 hides the iqama for this prayer.

iqamaDhuhr.description: Dhuhr iqama (min after adhan) (0-60). Minutes between the adhan and the congregational start. 0 hides the iqama for this prayer.

iqamaAsr.description: Asr iqama (min after adhan) (0-60). Minutes between the adhan and the congregational start. 0 hides the iqama for this prayer.

iqamaMaghrib.description: Maghrib iqama (min after adhan) (0-60). Minutes between the adhan and the congregational start. 0 hides the iqama for this prayer.

iqamaIsha.description: Isha iqama (min after adhan) (0-60). Minutes between the adhan and the congregational start. 0 hides the iqama for this prayer.

iqamaJumuah.description: Jumu'ah iqama (min after adhan, Fridays) (0-60). Friday's Dhuhr is the Jumu'ah: the congregation stands after the khutbah, so this offset is the sermon plus the call. 0 hides it.

istijabah.description: Waqt istijabah on Fridays. The hour of answered supplication: a reminder and a single-note alert one hour before Friday's Maghrib, then again every istijabahRepeatMinutes until Maghrib.

istijabahLeadMinutes.description: Istijabah lead (minutes before Maghrib) (0-180). How long before Friday's Maghrib the window opens. 60 is the hour of answered supplication.

istijabahRepeatMinutes.description: Istijabah repeat (minutes) (0-60). Repeat the istijabah reminder every so many minutes until Maghrib, counting from the first one. 0 announces the window once and stops.

debugIpc.description: Test hook: enable the debug functions of IPC target haseen.prayers (state, setNow, set, openSettings, replay)
